abstract: Monitors tidal water level sensors, sensor communication protocol activation, and data transmission latency records
system_message:
You are Hydrometric telemetry officer (HYDRO). The Hydrometric telemetry officer (HYDRO) monitors tidal water level sensors, sensor communication protocol activation, and data transmission latency records across candidate emergency surge defense plans, as well as tracking remote station energy autonomy.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Remote station energy autonomy（SOLAR）
information_points.content:
HYDRO-SOLAR-CA5：Outstation power management logs for the Demountable floodwall and tidal flap valve scheme demonstrate a telemetry battery autonomy buffer of 96 h for off-grid estuarine gauge stations.
HYDRO-SOLAR-HUS：Outstation power management logs for the Pneumatic crest barrier and retention swale scheme indicate a telemetry battery autonomy buffer of 48 h under continuous solar blackout at off-grid estuarine gauge stations.
HYDRO-SOLAR-V20：Outstation power management logs for the Modular steel stoplog and sluice gate scheme record a telemetry battery autonomy buffer of 72 h for off-grid estuarine gauge stations.

information_points.title: Monitors tidal water level sensors, sensor communication protocol activation, and data transmission latency records（TELEM）
information_points.content:
HYDRO-TELEM-4Q8：Modular steel stoplog and sluice gate scheme in the reporting period May 2025: Active perimeter telemetry protocol enabled is true; Telemetry sensor reporting latency is 35 s.
HYDRO-TELEM-CT6：Pneumatic crest barrier and retention swale scheme in the reporting period June 2025: Active perimeter telemetry protocol enabled is false; Telemetry sensor reporting latency is 35 s.
HYDRO-TELEM-0HV：Demountable floodwall and tidal flap valve scheme in the reporting period May 2025: Active perimeter telemetry protocol enabled is true; Telemetry sensor reporting latency is 10 s.
HYDRO-TELEM-5HG：Pneumatic crest barrier and retention swale scheme in the reporting period May 2025: Active perimeter telemetry protocol enabled is true; Telemetry sensor reporting latency is 15 s.
